Type: one-drawer wood nightstand
Use: bedside storage, holding a lamp and books; bedroom
Style: mid-century modern, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: oak with wire-brushed dark finish, brass bar pull
Colors: dark brown oak, warm gold
Shape: boxy case with thick framed edges, open cubby above one drawer, long horizontal bar pull, recessed plinth base, solid and grounded, medium size
Feel: warm, refined, sturdy
Goes with: cream bedding, brass accents, warm neutrals; modern or mid-century bedrooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet West, Mid-Century, Oak Nightstand Bedside, 1-Drawer Table, 22"W, Dark Oak Finish
product.description: This mid-century nightstand's brass pull and concealed drawer glides provide a modern style, while veneer made from hand-selected quarter-sawn oak adds a distinctive grain. A back-mounted power outlet and two USB ports make it even more functional. 22"W x 16"D x 23"H Solid hardwoods with finish of wire-brushed matte dark oak Modern and simple yet distinctive design No assembly needed. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty. Drawer is suspended on easy opening, concealed, self-closing extension guides
